title: Ausgewählte Werke Bd. 1 (German, 1922)
author: Vladimir Solovyov
description: The first volume of Vladimir Solovyov's selected works in the supplied German edition. It introduces a religious philosopher whose thought connects faith, ethics and the search for an integrated understanding of reality.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF). Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/ausgewhltewerk01solouoft).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
